gaps.lead: At no time did we think that Pedro might be planning to leave the country.
gaps.sentence: It ___ that Pedro might be planning to leave the country.
gaps.hint: it occurred to sb = sb thought
gaps.explanation: 'At no time did we think' becomes 'it never occurred to us'.

gaps.lead: Do you mind if I come over to see you later?
gaps.sentence: Do you ___ coming over to see you later?
gaps.explanation: 'Have any objection to me/my coming' is the formal equivalent of 'do you mind'.

gaps.lead: 'Why don't we hold the wedding outdoors?' said Ana.
gaps.explanation: suggest + that-clause, or suggest + -ing: suggested they hold / suggested holding.

gaps.lead: 'Don't touch the paintings in this room,' the guide warned us.
gaps.sentence: The guide warned ___ the paintings in that room.
gaps.explanation: Negative commands are reported with warned + object + not to + infinitive.

gaps.lead: Fewer students enrolled this year than we expected.
gaps.explanation: fewer than expected = not as many (students) as expected.
last did X in (year) = haven't done X since (year).
